photo.alt: A bridge over the Nile at the city

facts: Metropolitan area of about 5.3 million people (2018)
At the confluence of the White Nile and the Blue Nile
worth_knowing: Founded in 1821 by Muhammad Ali Pasha, north of the ancient city of Soba. Bridges link Khartoum proper to Khartoum North and Omdurman.
